latest_cos_commentary.headline: Mirus is a long-established (since 1999) restaurant data-warehousing and cross-system reporting platform, with dedicated Toast POS integration.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Overlaps with Genius's back_office analytics/reporting ambitions as a POS-agnostic data-warehouse layer that consolidates multiple operational systems; does not compete on POS or payments processing itself.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No recent funding, acquisition, or major product-launch news found as of research date; appears to be a stable, established vendor.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Mirus typically sits on top of an operator's existing POS as a reporting/data-warehouse layer — if a prospect already uses Mirus, position Genius's own back-office reporting as either complementary or a potential consolidation opportunity, not framed as an identical head-to-head swap without more detail.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, leadership, pricing, or financial details were confirmed in public sources reviewed.
